column1: # The verdict each repro script must give against the fux built from this
# commit, per platform. check.sh runs every script three ways and compares:
#   reproduce:          this table's value (0 reproduced, 1 not, 2 n/a here)
#   NEGATIVE_CONTROL=1: 1, or 2 where the reproduce column is 2
# A fix changes a 0 to 1 here in the same commit; a regression turns CI red.
